# Example Handout

## Problem 1

Consider the language $L_n$ over the alphabet $\\{0, 1\\}$

$$ L_n = \\{w \ | \ w \text{ is a binary number divisible by } n\\}$$

for a fixed positive integer $n$.

Design a DFA that recognizes $L_3$ (e.g. $L_n$ for $n = 3$)

Solution: https://george.chemmala.com/finite-automaton-autograder/fa_create?
